response: Time is a current that flows around us constantly, always moving but easy to ignore unless it sweeps against you.
Language is a river you cannot cross without learning to swim, even if you wanted to stay dry.

Nostalgia is a sweater that has been worn so many times that it is soft and familiar, worn through in places and a little threadbare but impossible to bear to part with because it still smells like home.
Doubt is a mirror that distorts your reflection until you're not sure which version of yourself is the real one.
Hope is a lantern that dims but never goes out in the long winter night, illuminating the present with the promise of dawn to come.
